verdict.rationale: Glama hosts a no-login browser-based MCP Inspector. It connects to remote Streamable HTTP and SSE endpoints, supports OAuth, bearer and custom-header auth, executes tools interactively, and logs every JSON-RPC message. It can also test local servers by tunneling them through mcp-proxy. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the inspector actually working.

support.subject: As a developer, I can exercise an MCP server's tools from a browser-based inspector or playground before integrating it

citations.quote: Glama's hosted inspector connects to remote Streamable HTTP and SSE endpoints so you can inspect available capabilities and test requests interactively
Test any MCP server from your browser. Supports every Model Context Protocol feature, including tools, resources, prompts, tasks, elicitation, sampling, and OAuth 2.1.
Inspect any MCP server directly from your browser. No login required.
Test your local MCP servers with the inspector by exposing them via a public tunnel using mcp-proxy.
